baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative to enter, the qualified land, and the clause that God wrote it for the addressees.
baseline_models.mechanism: Divine inscription establishes an assigned destination, while the imperative makes crossing into it the act that realizes the assignment. The gift is not presented as self-executing possession.

activation_trace.role: Movement into an interior supplies the realizing act by which the assignment becomes inhabited rather than merely named.
A purified-place image qualifies the destination as a bounded sacred place rather than generic territory.
Binding inscription that establishes a ruling or allotment supplies the assignment's normative force.

changed_reading.before: The ayah simply reports that a territory has been granted and orders its occupation.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents an assigned sacred destination whose grant must be enacted by entry.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The vocative naming a people, the plural imperative, and the prohibition on turning back.
baseline_models.mechanism: The address names an existing collectivity, but the rising-and-resolve branch makes its collective identity active: they become this people by rising together to the assigned act. Recurrent hesitation and mutual back-turning threaten to dissolve that posture.

activation_trace.role: The human-group image supplies the explicit collective being addressed.
Rising with resolve activates a performative dimension in that collective name: the group must stand up to its task.
Repetition, oscillation, and hesitation make the forbidden reversal a failure to sustain common resolve.
People turning their backs on one another supplies the social fracture latent in a plural retreat.

changed_reading.before: A pre-existing people receives a collective travel or battle order.
changed_reading.after: The order tests whether the addressees can constitute themselves as a people that rises and holds together in action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of returning, backs, turning over, and becoming losers.
baseline_models.mechanism: Three successive orientation roots turn retreat into a process rather than a single step: return takes the body backward, backward orientation flips the course, and the flip produces a diminished state. Loss is grammatically downstream of self-reversal.

activation_trace.role: Return to a prior place or state initiates the reversal sequence.
The back side gives the return a concrete bodily and directional orientation.
Turning a thing from one face to another converts backward motion into a changed condition.
General diminishment names the terminal state generated by the reversal.

changed_reading.before: Loss is an external penalty imposed after disobedient retreat.
changed_reading.after: Retreat is itself an inversion process that converts the agents into a diminished outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet's opening demand for complete fulfillment of bound obligations and its later recalled covenant revise divine writing from a deed of effortless possession into a commission whose human side is fulfilled by entry.

activation_trace.role: Binding inscription supplies the focus assignment that the covenant frame can construe as obligatory.
Actual passage inward supplies the performance by which the written commission is answered.
Completion without deficiency makes covenant response a fully performed act rather than verbal assent.
A firmly bound obligation supplies the legal-social frame for the focus assignment.
The emphatic covenant image joins remembered divine favor to an already confirmed human commitment.

structural_cues: 5:1 opens the packet by coupling faith with fulfillment of contracts.
5:7 recalls a covenant in the same sequence as hearing and obeying, and 5:12 again couples covenantal acts with promised entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding, fulfillment, and covenant language; I apply that frame to the focus inscription and infer that entry is its required performance. The live alternative is that the writing denotes an unconditional grant with obedience only added afterward.

changed_reading.before: God's writing is primarily a title to a promised place.
changed_reading.after: God's writing is also a covenantal commission: the allotted gift and the obligation to enter are one transaction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purification elsewhere in the packet is something performed and produced, while sustained standing, equity, and just conduct define a communal vocation. These cues activate the sacred quality of the land as an order the entrants must embody and maintain, not only a property the location already has.

activation_trace.role: Purity and removal from defilement supply the focus quality that can be enacted as well as located.
An inward or interior dimension lets entry describe incorporation into an order, while remaining anchored in the spatial imperative.
Purification through washing supplies a practiced transition from an unready state to a prepared one.
Sustained guardianship places standing responsibility beside the naming of a people and gives holiness a communal bearer.
Equity supplies the public norm the standing collective is charged to preserve.
Justice in conduct turns the sacred order into an enacted social practice.

structural_cues: 5:6 moves from bodily purification to God's stated purpose of purifying the addressees.
5:8 commands an enduring stance for God as witnesses with equity even toward a hated people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies produced purification and a justice-bearing collective; I infer that entrants are to reproduce those qualities in the sacred land. The live alternative is that the land's holiness is wholly locative and does not describe its entrants.

changed_reading.before: The command is to occupy a place that is already holy.
changed_reading.after: The command is also to enter and sustain a purified, just communal order appropriate to that place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding recollection of favor and sovereignty supplies prior capacity, while the next objection supplies real coercive opposition. The written land therefore reads less like entitlement to frictionless possession and more like responsibility proportionate to an already given capacity.

activation_trace.role: The binding allotment supplies the responsibility whose feasibility is tested by the surrounding claims of capacity and opposition.
A bestowed good condition supplies remembered enablement before the command is issued.
Sovereignty and authority supply political capacity rather than merely a claim to property.
Coercive overpowering names the contrary force that makes exercise of the prior capacity costly.

structural_cues: 5:20 lists divine favors and the making of kings immediately before the focus command.
5:22 answers the command by naming the inhabitants' overpowering force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior favor, sovereignty, and opposing coercion; I infer that the recollection establishes capacity for responsibility rather than a guarantee of ease. The live alternative is that 5:20 is encouragement by status alone.

changed_reading.before: Being written the land means the recipients are entitled to possess it without remainder.
changed_reading.after: Being written the land assigns empowered recipients a responsibility whose reality is shown precisely by resistance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The response to the focus imperative exposes two rival causal programs. The refusers require the obstacle to exit before they enter; the two men require entry through the gate before victory, with reliance sustaining the passage. Entry changes from arrival after safety into the threshold act through which conditions can change.

activation_trace.role: The focus command to move inward supplies the disputed first action in both causal programs.
Repeated inward movement is postponed and made conditional, exposing the refusers' sequence.
Movement outward names the prerequisite the refusers demand before undertaking entry.
Repeated inward movement is instead placed before the predicted change in power.
The entrance of a thing gives the command a concrete threshold at which commitment precedes outcome.
Overcoming force is placed after gate-entry, making victory the predicted consequence rather than its prerequisite.
Reliant dependence supplies the stance that can sustain action before control of the result.

structural_cues: 5:22 uses an until-condition: they will enter only after the inhabitants leave.
5:23 reverses that order: enter the gate, then overcoming follows.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two conditional sequences; I read their ordering as rival causal models and treat gate-entry as condition-changing action. The live alternative is that 5:23 offers encouragement specific to this battle, not a general threshold mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Enter once the destination is secure enough to receive you.
changed_reading.after: Enter the exposed threshold first; committed passage, not prior control, is the action through which the promised outcome becomes possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier sustained standing for God activates the rising potential in the focus address. The later declaration of sitting out the action, followed by a request for separation, then shows collective identity changing with posture: refusal does not leave the people socially unchanged.

activation_trace.role: The explicit human collective supplies the identity placed under pressure by the command.
Rising with resolve supplies the active posture latent in the collective address.
Sustained guardianship places responsible standing beside the naming of a people and prepares the focus vocative as a vocation.
Sitting out an action supplies the explicit counter-posture to collective rising.
Distinguishing and separating supplies the social consequence of the opposed postures.

structural_cues: 5:8 commands sustained standing for God before the narrative names the focus addressees as a people.
5:24 ends the refusal with a declaration of sitting, and 5:25 immediately asks for separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies standing language, a sitting refusal, and a separation request; I connect them as a social mechanism in the focus collective noun. The live alternative is a rhetorical contrast that does not redefine group membership.

changed_reading.before: The vocative addresses a stable people who may either obey or disobey.
changed_reading.after: The vocative calls a people into being through responsible rising; choosing to sit fractures the very collectivity being addressed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The aftermath externalizes the focus reversal. Declared sitting does not preserve a safe stationary outside; prohibition, measured years, and wandering on the same land-root convert a bounded sacred destination into prolonged unarrival. The loss is orientation and time as well as territory.

activation_trace.role: Ground opposite the sky supplies the concrete spatial field first presented as a destination.
The purified place gives that field bounded destination-quality.
Turning from one face to another supplies the spatial conversion later displayed by wandering.
Diminishment receives temporal and spatial content from the aftermath.
Fixed sitting supplies the attempted stationary alternative to risky entry.
Prevention and prohibition reverse access to the place previously written for them.
The year image makes lost orientation a measured duration rather than an instantaneous setback.
The same ground image returns as the medium of wandering instead of the reached destination.

structural_cues: The attempted alternative in 5:24 is to remain seated here.
In 5:26 the land is barred for forty years and becomes the field of wandering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the refusal, prohibition, duration, and wandering; I apply that consequence back to the focus turning and loss verbs and infer a conversion from destination to unarrival. The live alternative is to treat 5:26 only as an externally imposed penalty.

changed_reading.before: Turning back means missing the destination or returning to a prior place.
changed_reading.after: Turning back converts destination into circulation: the same land remains underfoot, but no longer functions as arrival, and years become part of the loss.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a ship branch of the sacredness root to a boat-pole branch under the alternate mapping of the return root. Both remain tied to focus words and produce a coherent directional mechanism, but downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain material analogy, never as a lexical claim that the sacred land is a ship.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The qualified destination, the prohibition on reversal, and the resulting destination or outcome.

activation_trace.role: A great-vessel image gives the sacred destination an exploratory container of passage.
Pushing a vessel with a pole supplies sustained directional effort as the material opposite of reversal.
Movement toward an outcome supplies the navigational destination threatened by a change of course.

changed_reading.before: The ayah gives a literal land-entry command and warns against retreat.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, it depicts committed passage that must keep its propulsion and heading or lose its destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links registration, an alternate stripping branch, separation, and a fruit leaving its shell. The chain remains anchored in the focus inscription, reversal, and loss and is sharpened by 5:25, but it should be rendered as an exploratory social-material model of de-enrollment, not as the lexical meaning of either reversal or transgression.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: God's writing for the group, the forbidden reversal, and becoming diminished.

activation_trace.role: Entering a name in a register or cohort supplies an enrollment image for the written assignment.
Stripping away a covering supplies the material image of exposing oneself by reversal.
Diminishment names the resulting loss of protected or enrolled standing.
Explicit distinction and separation supplies the social result of opposed responses.
A ripe fruit leaving its shell makes separation from a containing order materially visible.

changed_reading.before: Retreat forfeits access to an assigned possession.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, retreat strips the refusers out of the divinely inscribed cohort, so territorial loss is also loss of enrolled standing.

strongest_changes: The covenant roots turn what is written for the group from a passive deed into a commission fulfilled through entry.
The rival sequences in 5:22-23 make gate-entry a condition-changing act rather than arrival after safety.
Standing, sitting, and separation make the command constitutive of collective identity.
The aftermath converts sacred destination into measured wandering, giving loss spatial and temporal form.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah already contains a dense reversal cascade, and the packet externalizes each stage as covenant, threshold, posture, separation, prohibition, and wandering. The alternate mapping of the return root also supported two contained material outliers without displacing the stronger readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The purity-and-justice model may describe what entrants must embody, or the sacred adjective may remain only locative.
The standing potential in the collective noun is structurally reinforced but still depends on cross-form activation.
The alternate mapped-root outliers should remain analogical and exploratory.
Divine writing may retain an unconditional gift sense alongside the covenantal commission.
